text: You just watched a wrecking ball for seven seconds... [chuckles softly] a wrecking ball that was never there.
And if you can watch that for seven seconds... you can watch this for another fifteen.
Arabic... is the key to unlocking your religion.
Behind that door: every word of your salah. The Qur'an, in the language it came down in. Your du'a... finally understood.
Without Arabic, it's like trying to read a book... in the dark.
So... unlock it. رَفِيق Arabic dot com.
